data.description: A flame strike evokes a vertical column of divine fire. The spell deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level [maximum 15d6]. Half the damage is fire damage, but the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by resistance to fire-based attacks.
